JSON ↔ XML Converter

Convert JSON to XML or XML to JSON instantly in your browser.

JSON Input
XML Output

About JSON ↔ XML Conversion

JSON objects become XML elements. Arrays become repeated elements with the parent tag name. XML attributes are preserved as JSON properties prefixed with @. Text content becomes a #text property.

What is a JSON to XML Converter & XML to JSON Converter?

This bidirectional converter transforms JSON data into structured XML documents and vice versa. JSON objects become XML elements, arrays become repeated elements, and XML attributes are preserved as JSON properties.

Common Use Cases

Converting JSON API responses to XML for legacy systems
Transforming XML config files to JSON for modern applications
Migrating data between XML-based and JSON-based systems
Converting SOAP XML responses to JSON for REST APIs

Tips & Best Practices

💡XML requires a single root element — JSON objects with one key convert cleanly
💡XML attributes are prefixed with @ in the JSON output for clarity
💡Arrays in JSON become repeated XML elements with the same tag name

Frequently Asked Questions

Why convert JSON to XML?▼
Legacy enterprise systems, SOAP web services, and older APIs often require XML. Converting JSON to XML allows modern applications to communicate with these systems.
Does XML support arrays?▼
XML does not have a native array type. Arrays are represented as repeated elements with the same tag name. This converter handles this conversion automatically.
